method: Actual production scene and exact physical pauses. Both source-cluster getters off/on; same emitted bodies. Pre-tone-map FP16 scene/composed textures sampled into RGBA32F, divided by each capture storage 2^P.
limits: Diagnostic readbacks and PNG captures are not FPS measurements.

Sand mask is terrain-height/depth agreement above water; leaves use real coverage-depth attachment; water uses the production .70 alpha tag. Masks and counts are reported, not a claim of hand-reviewed segmentation.
Receiver grid is a bounded spatial sample; core crop reads every source texel in its rectangle. No absolute lux/nit or subjective appearance calibration.
Visible-core reduction needs a separate saved baseline from matching seed/phases/camera/lens/C. Technical pass without a baseline does not accept core reduction.
Preferences/overrides are restored; physical time and emitted events cannot be rewound.
baselineScope: Same current choreography/physics and shader/lens. Baseline uses the saved former fireworks optical representation and local-light range; its receiver getter aliases the original cloud clusters. Not a comparison of earlier choreography.
